<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data: a singlet (3 H) at 2.23 ppm suggests an aromatic methyl group; two triplets (2 H each, J≈7 Hz) indicate a –CH₂‑CH₂‑ linker; the aromatic region shows 9 protons, consistent with a monosubstituted phenyl ring (5 H) and a para‑methyl‑substituted phenyl ring (4 H). A structure that fits these features is a para‑methyl‑phenyl group linked via an ethyl chain to an unsubstituted phenyl ring: **para‑tolyl‑CH₂‑CH₂‑phenyl**. The corresponding SMILES string is `Cc1ccc(cc1)CCc2ccccc2`. This SMILES is valid and matches the observed NMR pattern. 
</thought>
<final_answer>Cc1ccc(cc1)CCc2ccccc2</final_answer>
